description: This Java class defines the DeleteFeatureDefinitionStrategy, which handles the deletion of feature definitions within a Thing entity in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It processes DeleteFeatureDefinition commands by removing feature definitions from a specific Thing and generating appropriate events and results.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureDefinitionStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the deletion of feature definitions in a Thing entity by processing the DeleteFeatureDefinition command and producing resulting events or errors.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the deletion of a feature definition within a given context if the feature exists, producing a success or error result.

methods.name: getDeleteFeatureDefinitionResult
methods.description: Constructs the result and event for a successful feature definition deletion, or returns an error if the feature definition isn't found.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag of the current feature before deletion for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns empty, indicating no update to the entity tag after deletion.
